description: This file implements base64 encoding and decoding functionality using OpenSSL BIO abstraction, including methods for reading, writing, control operations, and initialization/cleanup of a base64 BIO filter.

methods.name: b64_new
methods.description: Initializes a new base64 BIO context and associates it with the BIO structure.

methods.name: b64_free
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with the base64 BIO context.

methods.name: b64_read
methods.description: Reads base64-decoded data from the BIO stream.

methods.name: b64_write
methods.description: Encodes data to base64 and writes it to the BIO stream.

methods.name: b64_ctrl
methods.description: Performs control operations such as reset, flush, and pending data checks on the BIO.

methods.name: b64_callback_ctrl
methods.description: Handles callback control for the BIO.

methods.name: BIO_f_base64
methods.description: Returns the BIO_METHOD structure for base64 encoding/decoding.
